gaps.lead: I only found out the truth because I asked.
gaps.sentence: I wouldn't have found out the truth ___ asked.
gaps.explanation: 'Because I asked' → 'if I hadn't asked' — a third conditional.

gaps.lead: A professional will repair the roof next week.
gaps.explanation: 'Have something done' — arranged service: have the roof repaired.

gaps.lead: Simon really ought to make a decision about his future.
gaps.sentence: It's high time Simon ___ about his future.
gaps.hint: it's high time + past; make a decision = make up one's mind
gaps.explanation: 'It's high time' takes the past subjunctive: 'made up his mind'.

gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.

gaps.lead: It wasn't necessary for her to bring any food — there was plenty.
gaps.explanation: needn't have + participle = it wasn't necessary, but she did it.

gaps.lead: The results were announced, and immediately people began celebrating.
gaps.sentence: The results had ___ people began celebrating.
gaps.explanation: No sooner had the results been announced than people began…
